answer_format.manual: Click suggested options when matching, then paste narrative in text/voice composer above. Do not manually paste storage headings into the visible text input.
answer_format.storage_example:
Selected options:
- Aching
- Tight

Additional details:
My own description.
answer_format.unknown: Use the I’m not sure control to retain uncertainty; do not invent values.
answer_format.skip: Use Prefer not to answer / skip where appropriate.
answer_format.previous_answers: For current_medications and allergies a prior same-patient visit may show an explicit Use this answer for this visit card with date. It is not auto-filled; click and verify/update for the new visit.

ai_followup.presentation: Wizard, one question per step, up to 5 questions in one planned batch; review all answers then submit together.
ai_followup.selection: May show up to 3 A/B/C suggestions, otherwise free text; all questions allow typed/voice custom answer and uncertainty/skip.
ai_followup.resume: Draft answers save and survive reload. Already completed batches open review; Edit returns to one question.
ai_followup.rounds: Normally one batch. Exceptional second batch only for a new explicit medicine/allergy conflict.
ai_followup.guide_instruction: Provide an answer bank based on the fictional case, not a guaranteed question order. If a generated question is not covered by the case, choose uncertainty/skip rather than fabricate.
ai_followup.eligible_target_note: initial_eligible_after_baseline is from a completed empty in-memory baseline, before AI extraction. Actual supplied evidence can resolve targets, activate conditional fields, and add per-medicine/test/reading targets.

attachments.flow: Upload files. If using Extract details, review extracted text before adding it to patient notes. Final approved sharing includes attachments.
attachments.synthetic_marking: Every generated upload should prominently say FICTIONAL / TEST DATA / NOT FOR CLINICAL USE.

sharing.review: Review patient summary and AI assessment, correct any inaccuracies, then enter an existing doctor-account email, check approval, and approve/share.
sharing.identity: Patient and doctor email accounts must differ. A fictional test persona is a label/data fixture, not an invented working email login.
